name: AION 2 (North America)
note: AION 2's servers sit behind Cloudflare, so a ping reaches Cloudflare's nearest edge, not the server. ExitLag routes AION 2 to US Phoenix, so this is the time to Oracle Cloud's Phoenix region by your normal route.

name: ARC Raiders
note: ARC Raiders' servers run straight in Google Cloud regions (Sydney, Melbourne and others) and ignore ping, so this is the time to Google's own latency service (gcping) in the server's region.
